svg.title: Element-wise subslot sampling and pilot/data frame structure
svg.desc: A cross section highlights one receiving element. Its squared RF is averaged in nine subslots and forms one row of the frame intensity matrix. The known pilot segment provides the channel estimate used for payload symbol detection. Intermediate symbols are omitted.
